summary: Man in his 20s fell ~20 ft lead climbing the Yellow Spur route on the Red Garden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park, after calling for slack and missing a handhold; serious but non-life-threatening injuries; BCSO, RMRG, Rocky Mountain Fire Authority, and Colorado Parks & Wildlife ran a ~3-hour technical rescue — litter carry to ambulance, transported to area hospital
location: Yellow Spur, Red Garden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: BCSO, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Rocky Mountain Fire Authority, Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Source quotes the Daily Camera 2019-08-14 article verbatim (Daily Camera fetch failed, paywall/JS); run 646 BCSO chunk
